summary.text: Practical guides for creating, publishing, connecting, and improving Tally forms.

context.text: Tally describes its editor as working like a document: type to build a form and use / to insert blocks.
Tally offers unlimited forms and submissions on its free plan, subject to its fair use policy. Some settings and insights require Pro or Business.

links.label: Create a form
links.description: Add questions and content, customize the form, then publish and share it.

links.label: Input blocks
links.description: Choose fields for text, choices, dates, files, payments, and other responses.

links.label: Use form templates
links.description: Start from a ready-made template or save a form as a reusable template.

links.label: Create a multi-step form
links.description: Add page breaks, group questions, and configure eligible one-question pages to auto-jump.

links.label: Configure form settings
links.description: Manage access, notifications, completion behavior, and respondent options.

links.label: Conditional logic
links.description: Show or hide blocks, require answers, calculate values, and send respondents along different paths.

links.label: Hidden fields
links.description: Pass URL parameters into a form to track sources or reuse information you already have.

links.label: Calculated fields
links.description: Build scores, prices, and text values from answers; includes formula and troubleshooting guidance.

links.label: Answer piping
links.description: Insert earlier answers into later questions, text, and thank-you messages.

links.label: Thank You pages
links.description: Customize the post-submission page or create different pages for different logic paths.

links.label: Customize your form
links.description: Adjust themes, colors, fonts, layout, images, and other design elements.

links.label: Embed a form
links.description: Add a standard, popup, or full-page form to a website and configure its appearance.

links.label: Popup forms
links.description: Set popup triggers and appearance, then add the generated code to a site.

links.label: Redirect on completion
links.description: Send respondents to another URL after submission, optionally using form data.

links.label: Build accessible forms
links.description: Review Tally’s accessibility guidance and known limitation for the signature field; test your specific form.

links.label: Form insights
links.description: Review answer charts and visit metrics; drop-off insights require Pro.

links.label: Email notifications
links.description: Set up submission emails for form owners or respondents.

links.label: File uploads
links.description: Collect respondent files, set file rules, and access uploads from submissions.

links.label: Payment forms
links.description: Connect Stripe to collect card payments; standard Stripe fees apply.

links.label: Partial submissions
links.description: Capture unfinished entries after enabling this Pro setting; earlier entries are not recovered.

links.label: Prevent duplicate submissions
links.description: Choose an identifier to deter repeat entries and understand its limitations.

links.label: Integration directory
links.description: Find guides for direct connections, automation tools, analytics, embeds, and the API.

links.label: Google Sheets integration
links.description: Sync submissions to a spreadsheet and check delivery logs when responses are missing.

links.label: Notion integration
links.description: Map form fields to Notion database properties and troubleshoot syncing.

links.label: Webhooks
links.description: Send new submissions as JSON to your endpoint, with signing and retry guidance.

links.label: Tally API
links.description: Programmatically manage forms and submissions; review authentication, pagination, versioning, and rate limits.

links.label: Frequently asked questions
links.description: Find answers about exports, saved answers, embeds, account settings, and common form questions.

links.label: Delete and recover form data
links.description: Delete forms or submissions and restore items from Trash within 90 days, unless permanently removed.

links.label: Form version history
links.description: Preview and restore saved versions; republish to update an already-published form.

links.label: GDPR guidance
links.description: Read Tally’s account of its data-processing roles and privacy measures; this is not legal advice.

links.label: Plans and pricing
links.description: Check which needs may call for Pro or Business rather than the free plan.

links.label: Fair use policy
links.description: Review usage guidance and when Tally may contact you about a custom plan.

raw.explanation: Organized the help resources around the form-building workflow, with troubleshooting and data management close at hand. Pricing appears only where readers may need to check feature availability.
